captured.caption:
Phoenix's skyline hits differently depending on where you're standing, and these five hotels have the best seats in the house.
From a Camelback Mountain-facing balcony in the Biltmore-Arcadia corridor to a mid-century rooftop pool deck in Old Town Scottsdale, every hotel in this roundup earns its place for one reason: the view is the amenity. We've mapped out exactly where to stand (or wake up), which room category gets you there, and what it'll cost you in October before peak winter rates arrive in November. One of these even punches well above its price tier, with a full downtown panorama on a standard booking. Five distinct vantage points. Zero filler.
Follow @arizona.explores for more trip-planning intel across the state, and save this one before your next Phoenix booking.

These take just a few simple steps and taste like classic pumpkin pie, but without the hassle of baking an entire pie.

Ingredients:
12 medium/large Medjool dates (240–250 g), pitted
⅓ cup pumpkin puree
¼ teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
¼ teaspoon cinnamon
¼ cup + 2 tablespoons coconut flour
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
5 oz (1 cup) semi-sweet chocolate chips (or dark chocolate)
1 teaspoon coconut oil
1 tablespoon sea salt flakes (optional)
